channel.title: Discover Your Purpose
channel.description: Discover Your Purpose is a faith-based podcast hosted by Pastor Phillip Sundar from CJC Life Church in San Antonio, Texas. Each episode is designed to inspire, equip, and empower you to uncover your God-given purpose. Through biblical wisdom, real-life stories, and practical insights, Pastor Phillip helps you navigate life's challenges and step into your divine calling. Whether you're searching for direction, seeking spiritual growth, or looking to deepen your relationship with God, this podcast will guide you on your journey to purpose. Tune in and start discovering the life you were created to live.
channel.itunes:author: Phillip Sundar
